name: Beth Moses
profileSummary: Beth Moses is a commercial astronaut, former interiors program manager, and former chief astronaut instructor for Virgin Galactic's SpaceShipTwo program. She was the first woman to make a spaceflight on a commercially launched vehicle, the VSS Unity VF-01 flight of 22 February 2019. She was also part of the six-member crew that flew in the first fully-crewed test flight to space on July 11, 2021, aboard VSS Unity.
